settings.title: Easy *returns* & refunds
settings.subtitle: Changed your mind or need another size? Here's how returns, exchanges and refunds work.
settings.ribbon: 7-day returns, Free exchanges on faulty items, Refunds to your original payment, Return in any branch

settings.question: How long do I have to return an item?
settings.answer: 7 days from delivery (or from purchase in a branch).

settings.question: Can I return items on sale?
settings.answer: Sale items can be exchanged but not refunded, unless they are faulty.

settings.question: My item arrived damaged. What now?
settings.answer: Contact us within 48 hours with your order number and a photo. We'll replace, repair or refund it and cover the return delivery.

settings.question: How will I get my money back?
settings.answer: To your original payment method. Cash on delivery orders are refunded in cash at a branch, or by bank transfer or mobile wallet.

settings.title: Message us
settings.text: Send your order number on WhatsApp or email within 7 days of delivery.

settings.title: Pack it
settings.text: Keep the item unused, with its tags and original packaging.

settings.title: Hand it over
settings.text: Drop it at any branch, or we arrange a pickup with the courier.

settings.title: Get your refund
settings.text: Exchange it or get your money back once we check the item.

settings.heading: Start your return now
settings.text: Send us your order number and we'll guide you step by step.
